description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以達成以下目標：培養基礎英文書寫能力，深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, and discuss topics from their course materials in order to achieve the following learning objectives: develop basic English writing skills, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others.

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

records.)

或更嚴重的學術處分。(Plagiarism policies apply to AI-generated content. Submitting 
work you did not create yourself may result in a failing grade or more serious academic 
penalties.)

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
• 您必須認真遵守⽤於確認語詞和想法來源的標準規則。如果您使⽤了短語或引語，或 者是另⼀位作者的⽤語或想法，則必須確認這些⽤語或想法的來源，並在報告中標註 這些素材的出處。作者的姓名和在句⼦末尾，包含使⽤原材料的⾴碼。
  • 如果抄襲或以其他⽅式來掩蔽您的作品來源，您的作業將為零分。若屢次不改，將依 學⽣獎懲辦法提送獎懲委員會處分。
  • 如果您作作業感到惶恐，請不要試圖作抄襲或作弊。可以與我聯繫，我們可以協商找 出可幫助您完成學業的⽅案。⼀旦作弊，要協商任何問題都為時已晚。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
• You must follow standard rules for citing sources of words and ideas. If you use phrases, quotes, or ideas from another author, you must credit the source and include the author’s name and page number at the end of the sentence.
  • Plagiarism or hiding the origin of your work will result in a zero grade. Repeated violations will be reported to the disciplinary committee.
  • If you feel anxious about the assignment, do not resort to plagiarism or cheating. Contact me instead—we can work out a solution to help you succeed. Once you cheat, it’s too late to negotiate.
